description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'ResetPasswordServiceTest' for the 'ResetPasswordService' in the OrangeHRM project. It includes setup for test fixtures, and multiple test methods verifying the behavior of password reset functionalities, email sending, URL validation, and user validation within the authentication service context.

classes.name: ResetPasswordServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing various functionalities of the ResetPasswordService, including password reset, email notifications, URL validation, and user validation within the OrangeHRM authentication module.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixture, including instantiating the ResetPasswordService, loading test data, and setting up mock services.

methods.name: testGetEmailService
methods.description: Verifies that the ResetPasswordService correctly returns an instance of EmailService.

methods.name: testResetPasswordDao
methods.description: Checks that the ResetPasswordService correctly returns an instance of ResetPasswordDao.

methods.name: testHasPasswordResetRequestNotExpired
methods.description: Asserts that a retrieved ResetPasswordRequest has not expired.

methods.name: testExtractPasswordResetMetaData
methods.description: Tests the extraction of metadata from a password reset code string.

methods.name: testGenerateEmailBody
methods.description: Checks that the email body generated for a password reset email is a string.

methods.name: testSearchForUserRecord
methods.description: Verifies the search functionality for user records based on username, expecting correct user retrieval or null.

methods.name: testSendPasswordResetCodeEmail
methods.description: Tests email sending functionality with a mock URL generator, asserting expected behavior.

methods.name: testGeneratePasswordResetCode
methods.description: Ensures password reset code is generated and can be parsed back to the username.

methods.name: testSaveResetPassword
methods.description: Tests saving reset password credentials returns expected success or failure.

methods.name: testLogPasswordResetRequest
methods.description: Validates logging of password reset requests, including mock behaviors.

methods.name: testValidateUrl
methods.description: Checks URL validation returns null for invalid codes, or a user for valid codes.

methods.name: testValidateUser
methods.description: Verifies user validation logic based on user entity.
